item.title: Father who gave gun to Georgia school shooting suspect for Christmas is guilty of 2nd-degree murder
item.description: WINDER, Ga. (AP) — A Georgia man who gave his teenage son the gun he's accused of using to kill two students and two teachers at a high school was convicted Tuesday of second-degree murder and involuntary manslaughter. item.title: Detroit man whose confession to 1999 murder was coerced by rogue cop released from prison
item.description: A man in prison for more than 25 years was freed Tuesday after prosecutors acknowledged that his confession to a Detroit murder in 1999 was coerced by a rogue police officer.

item.title: Grand Rapids Public Library winding down portable hot spot program
item.description: The Grand Rapids Public Library is winding down its hot spot lending program, citing the high cost of maintaining the collection for a relatively low number of users.

item.title: More ice options needed for Kalamazoo community, study finds
item.description: Findings from a recent study have highlighted the need for more ice options in the Kalamazoo-area ahead of anticipated venue changes.

item.title: Stolen diesel fuel was resold in parking lots, investigators say
item.description: A criminal enterprise accused of reselling thousands of gallons of diesel fuel purchased with stolen information was recently busted following a monthslong investigation by the Kent County Sheriff’s Office.

item.title: Grand Rapids group aims to end chronic homelessness this year
item.description: The organizers behind Kent County’s' 100 in 100 Campaign are announcing a new project to house chronically homeless individuals and provide support for them to live independently.
